# Third-party components: Contracts

<!-- Generated by sbom/generate.mjs from contracts/package-lock.json, contracts/soldeer.lock and sbom/components.json. Do not edit; run node sbom/generate.mjs. -->

Every third-party component of `contracts/` with its licence. The same list in
CycloneDX 1.6: [`contracts.cdx.json`](contracts.cdx.json). How it is made and what it
does not cover: [README.md](README.md).

**Production** components are what a production install of the part contains: what its
app, images or deployed contracts are built from, build tools included. **Development**
components only build, test or run it locally.
